bugs.title: Failed-deposit / saved drafts were treated as real shifts
bugs.steps: Create a shift, fail the deposit (insufficient balance) or 'Lưu nháp'.
bugs.expected: Draft is a saved form snapshot, not a published job; it never appears in shift lists / lifecycle / calendar / worker job list, and has no cancel/refund.
bugs.actual: A Shift with status=Draft lingered in the main shift list, showed in employer detail/stats/calendar, entered status logic, and 'Lưu nháp'/'Quay lại chỉnh sửa' didn't do anything useful.
bugs.fix: Added a dedicated ShiftDraft model + shiftDraftStore (save/update/remove, savedAt/updatedAt). New-shift page 'Lưu nháp' saves a ShiftDraft (incomplete allowed); 'Quay lại chỉnh sửa' restores ALL fields; insufficient-balance 'Lưu nháp' discards the transient Draft shift via shiftStore.discardDraftShift and saves a ShiftDraft. 'Bản nháp đã lưu' section lists drafts with Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa / Xóa bản nháp. byEmployer + employer dashboard/schedule exclude Draft; lifecycle never moves Draft; public listing already excludes it.
tests: e2e/22-core-stability-8.spec.ts Part 1 (save/restore/delete; worker never sees a draft)

bugs.title: On-site contact person/phone were optional for publish
bugs.steps: Create + deposit a shift without an on-site contact.
bugs.expected: Người phụ trách + SĐT required to publish/deposit (numeric phone); draft can save incomplete.
bugs.fix: ShiftForm marks contact name + phone required and validates on the publish submit (digits-only phone via isValidVNPhone). simulateDeposit enforces CONTACT_PERSON_REQUIRED / CONTACT_PHONE_REQUIRED in the store before any mutation. Drafts bypass (Lưu nháp doesn't validate).

bugs.title: A shift starting at 13:00 still showed 'Đang tuyển' at 13:59
bugs.steps: Open a started shift (Approved roster, no check-in) any time after start.
bugs.expected: Recruiting window closes at start; shift shows 'Đang diễn ra' (InProgress), consistent across roles/pages.
bugs.actual: An Approved-but-not-checked-in roster kept the shift Published ('Đang tuyển') after start.
bugs.fix: suggestShiftStatus: a Published/FullyBooked shift with an active roster rolls to InProgress at start (was gated on check-in). getShiftDisplayPhase: returns InProgress once now>=start (was Upcoming without check-in). InProgress→Expired when ended with no check-in. The single runLifecycleSync engine (already invoked on AppHydrator + every dashboard/detail/list mount) makes the state consistent everywhere.
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability8.test.ts (12:59 Published, 13:00 InProgress, 13:59 InProgress not Published)
updated phase10cStab1Batch3/Batch4 lifecycle assertions to the new rule

bugs.title: Employer mark-present prematurely unlocked worker check-out
bugs.steps: Employer marks a worker present before the worker self-checks-in.
bugs.expected: Two-sided confirmation: employer mark-present establishes presence but the worker must still press 'Tôi đã có mặt'; check-out only after the worker's own check-in + shift conditions.
bugs.actual: markPresentByEmployer set the worker's checkInAt, so the worker UI jumped to check-out without self-confirming.
bugs.fix: markPresentByEmployer now sets markedPresentAt (+ status CheckedIn for escrow) but NOT the worker's own checkInAt. canCheckOut requires the worker's checkInAt. checkIn accepts the employer-marked-present case (status CheckedIn, no checkInAt) so 'Tôi đã có mặt' stamps it; canCheckIn allows that confirmation through the shift. The worker dashboard already shows the 'hãy xác nhận có mặt' notice (lifecycle.mismatch.workerNotCheckedIn).
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability8.test.ts (mark-present ≠ checkInAt; checkout locked until self check-in)
updated phase10cStab1 canWorkerCheckOut test to carry checkInAt

bugs.title: Expired empty deposited shift did not refund the deposit
bugs.steps: A deposited shift expires with zero approved workers.
bugs.expected: Full deposit refunded to the wallet + ledger entry + notification deeplinking to wallet history.
bugs.actual: ShiftExpiredEmpty notified but did not refund the held deposit.
bugs.fix: The ShiftExpiredEmpty lifecycle branch now credits the full deposit (EmployerUnusedRefund), flips escrow to Refunded (idempotent — gated on dedupeKey + escrow state), and the notification deeplinks to ?modal=wallet. Unused-slot refund on completion (pay-N, refund-rest) was already present.
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability8.test.ts (empty-expiry full refund, no duplicate on re-sync)

bugs.title: No employer policy for understaffed shifts (run-with-approved vs require-full)
bugs.steps: Configure how a shift behaves when not enough workers are approved.
bugs.expected: Employer setting: 'Vẫn chạy với số người đã duyệt' (default) or 'Chỉ chạy khi đủ số người' (auto-cancel + refund if understaffed at start).
bugs.fix: Added Employer.understaffedPolicy + a profile settings card (default RunWithApproved). Lifecycle Step 2c: RequireFull + understaffed + no check-in at start → system auto-cancel (escrow Refunded, full deposit back, approved workers → CancelledByEmployer with no penalty, both sides notified, deeplink to wallet). RunWithApproved runs with whoever was approved.
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability8.test.ts (RequireFull auto-cancel+refund; RunWithApproved does not cancel)

productDecisions.decision: Draft is a saved form snapshot, not a published job. Stored in a separate ShiftDraft model/store; never enters the public shift lifecycle.
Two-sided attendance confirmation. Employer mark-present establishes presence but the worker must still self-confirm ('Tôi đã có mặt') before check-out unlocks (Part 4.6 recommended rule).
Default understaffed policy is 'RunWithApproved' (casual jobs can operate with fewer people). Employers may opt into 'RequireFull'.

Absent→present reversal (CORE-STABILITY-7) remains blocked when an open dispute exists; the auto-cancel path is a SYSTEM action that bypasses the human 6h cancel gate but never touches a disputed application.
